source: Postery (postery.com/en-gb), Wikimedia Commons (public-domain artworks), Patch Plants (patchplants.com)
notes: Prints: framed outer size = poster size + 2×12mm Postery frame profile, 22mm deep. Public-domain works are priced as the Postery frame only.
Posterlounge UK had good Bauhaus listings but blocked the IP after a few requests (429 then TLS reset), so retail prints come from Postery.

Plants: Patch lists height incl. pot and nursery pot size; spread is estimated from the studio photos. Decorative pots chosen from Patch's range (warm/natural); the primary photo may show a different pot.

products.name: Bauhaus Ausstellung 1923 poster, Joost Schmidt (framed)
products.variant: 50×70 cm portrait, black wood frame, narrow white mount

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of the Staatliches Bauhaus Ausstellung poster, Joost Schmidt, 1923 (public domain). Yellow-ochre ground with a bold constructivist figure: a thick red ring at upper left, a black arch and upright band forming an S-curve down the centre, a black J-hook at lower right, red bars at middle right. BAUHAUS in black capitals across the top, STAATLICHES small in red up the left, AUSSTELLUNG in black along the lower left, WEIMAR at the bottom, 1923 vertical on the right. Slim matte black frame, narrow white mount.
products.geometryNotes: Postery black wood frame 50×70 (12mm profile, 22mm deep) → outer 524×724×22. Commons scan ratio 0.77 (409×530 px), so the artwork panel is 476×616 inside a narrow white mount.

products.name: Composition VIII, Wassily Kandinsky (framed)
products.variant: 100×70 cm landscape, oak frame, white mount

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of Composition VIII, Wassily Kandinsky, 1923 (public domain). A landscape composition on a pale cream ground: a large black-ringed violet-and-black circle at upper left, a cluster of small red, blue and yellow circles, criss-crossing thin black lines, sharp triangles and semicircles, chequerboard strips and grids spread across the lower right — airy, precise geometric abstraction. Light natural oak frame with a wide white mount.
products.geometryNotes: Postery oak frame 70×100 hung landscape → outer 1024×724×22. Artwork ratio 1.373 → panel 820×597 in a white mount.

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of Composition II in Red, Blue and Yellow, Piet Mondrian, 1930 (public domain). A near-square grid of thick black lines on white: a large bright red square fills the upper right, a small blue square at lower left, a small yellow rectangle at lower right, white rectangles elsewhere. White wood frame with a white passe-partout.
products.geometryNotes: Postery 50×50 square frame with passe-partout → outer 524×524×22. Artwork panel 330×335 (ratio 0.986).

products.name: Castle and Sun, Paul Klee (framed)
products.variant: 40×30 cm landscape, oak frame, white mount

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of Castle and Sun (Burg und Sonne), Paul Klee, 1928 (public domain). products.name: Bauhaus Stairway, Oskar Schlemmer (framed)
products.variant: 70×100 cm portrait, black wood frame, white mount

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of Bauhaus Stairway (Bauhaustreppe), Oskar Schlemmer, 1932 (public domain). Stylised mannequin-like figures climb a pale blue-grey staircase towards tall gridded windows; a figure in a bright red-orange top in the centre, others in browns, white and black, smooth rounded heads, soft light — a calm, architectural composition. Matte black wood frame with a white mount.
products.geometryNotes: Postery black frame 70×100 → outer 724×1024×22. Artwork ratio 0.707 → panel 560×792.

products.name: Construction A II, László Moholy-Nagy (framed)
products.variant: 50×40 cm landscape, white wood frame, white mount

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of Construction A II, László Moholy-Nagy, 1924 (public domain). On a warm ochre-tan ground, overlapping translucent planes: a long black parallelogram band across the middle, a yellow diagonal bar, a red circle, pale grey and white transparent quadrilaterals layered over one another — crisp constructivist geometry. White wood frame with a white mount.
products.geometryNotes: Postery white frame 40×50 hung landscape → outer 524×424×22. Artwork ratio 1.184 → panel 380×321.

products.name: Bauhaus Ausstellung postcard, Wassily Kandinsky (framed)
products.variant: 30×40 cm portrait, oak frame, white mount

price.note: frame only (Postery); the public-domain print is self-sourced

products.description: Framed print of Kandinsky's postcard for the 1923 Bauhaus Ausstellung, Weimar (public domain). Light oak frame with a white mount.
